status: development: every month had been seen when the candidates were written

in_use.name: in_use
in_use.what: The rule in use, run through this script's own loop.

without_audience.name: without_audience
without_audience.what: The rule in use with the audience categories taken out of the rail share.

ticketed_audience.name: ticketed_audience
ticketed_audience.what: Audience effect learned from the years with ticket counts; earlier years get their own.

act_share.name: act_share
act_share.what: The rule in use plus the act's own earlier rail share per ticket (years with ticket counts).

ticketed_audience_act_share.name: ticketed_audience_act_share
ticketed_audience_act_share.what: Every audience category by era, plus the act's own earlier rail share per ticket.

act_share_all_years.name: act_share_all_years
act_share_all_years.what: The rule in use plus the act's earlier rail share from every year.

without_audience_act_share.name: without_audience_act_share
without_audience_act_share.what: No audience category; the act's own earlier rail share per ticket instead.

ticketed_senior.name: ticketed_senior
ticketed_senior.what: Only the senior-audience effect is learned from the years with ticket counts.

ticketed_senior_act_share.name: ticketed_senior_act_share
ticketed_senior_act_share.what: The senior-audience effect on the rail share is learned from the sessions that have a ticket count (from 2025-01-01); earlier years get their own, so a small crowd is not read as a crowd that rides less. An act's own earlier rail share per ticket, from those same years, moves its forecast.
